tasks.label: llama-completion: start
tasks.detail: Start the FIM completion server (systemd user unit on 127.0.0.1:8082).
tasks.command: systemctl --user start llama-completion.service && echo 'llama-completion started (the model may still be loading)'

tasks.label: llama-completion: stop
tasks.detail: Stop the FIM completion server and free its VRAM.

tasks.label: llama-completion: restart
tasks.command: systemctl --user restart llama-completion.service && echo 'llama-completion restarted (the model may still be loading)'

tasks.label: llama-completion: status
tasks.detail: Show unit state and probe the /health endpoint.
tasks.command: systemctl --user --no-pager --full status llama-completion.service || true; echo; printf 'health: '; curl -fsS -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:8082/health || echo 'not ready'
